verdict.rationale: Google Workspace is a SaaS platform, not an agent, so publishing an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents an official Workspace MCP server or MCP endpoint. Discovery Documents, the APIs Explorer, Apps Script and the REST Admin APIs are only developer building blocks, not an MCP server, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
